title: GrantThai provenance record
description: Provenance metadata attached to any authored value. Draft, Phase 0. derived_from: core/04@sha256:c23217441176d90f129e525248c24103575bcd85841020b2842fd237638d269a (provenance classes), core/02@sha256:d36e6922a01296bd5001733ca7d5e1d2f6927fbcc08ffebde176d0d2159535a4 (field record base fields), amended per docs/design/PLAN.md section E.

provenance_class.description: The four unchanged provenance classes (plan section E).

source_type.description: core/01 types plus the four GrantThai additions.

evidence_role.description: Lived experience is ORIENTING by default; becomes SUPPORTING only when re-collected under a declared method (P5).

authored_by.description: Self-declared and unverified. Never a quality signal on its own; the output disclaimer states this explicitly.

derived_from.description: Lineage back to a specific handoff-package core file, e.g. core/02@sha256:<hash>.

then.description: Rule: a citizen's account is SOURCE only for the narrow claim 'person reported X', never for the underlying fact itself.
